name: HRM_GUI_SCR
title: Scroll mode on tap, GUI on hold; left GUI on left half, right GUI on right half

name: WNEXT
title: Holds Alt and taps Tab, then waits for 650ms, if the key is tapped again, it will send another Tab; if there is no tap, Alt will turn off. This allows you to cycle through windows with only one key

name: WPREV
title: Holds Alt and taps Shift+Tab. See Alt Tab description

name: HRM_RGUI_EXLM
title: ! on tap, right GUI on hold
